claim: Asked through the front door in one of fifteen plain phrasings, a request to copy a file to a new name, to rename a file to a new name, or to append one line to a file leaves the folder holding exactly what the request determines and nothing else changed; the same request with a word no row accounts for, with a destination that already exists, or naming a file that is not there is refused and the folder is left byte for byte as it was.
input_class: Folders of two to four text files with made-up bare names (four extensions), each holding zero to five lines of zero to four words, some non-ASCII, with or without a final newline; one request per folder drawn from five phrasings each of copy, rename and append (the generator's own tables), with source and destination in that folder; the appended line is one made-up token, or two or three made-up tokens in double quotes; 60 % plain requests, about 20 % with one of twenty foreign words inserted before the first name, about 10 % whose destination exists, 10 % whose named file is absent.
scope_limits: NO phrasing outside the fifteen in the generator's tables; other wordings are mostly refused and that is not measured here
NO overwriting: a request that asks to replace an existing destination is never generated
NO directories as source or destination, no destination in another or a missing folder, no absolute paths, no path outside the repository
NO appended line that is an ordinary English word, contains a quotation mark, or spans lines
NO files above a few hundred bytes, no binary content, no symbolic links, no concurrent writers
NO claim about any other file operation, and nothing that starts a program

solver.note: the adapter writes the described folder to a scratch path, asks the one front door, and reads the folder back; no file-changing logic is in it

declared.lineage: computed from the generator's description of the files and the request; parses no sentence, reads no file, imports no runtime module

falsification_condition: One fresh instance on which the folder afterwards differs by one byte or one name from what the request determines, or a request that must be refused is answered or changes anything, or a plain request in one of the fifteen phrasings is refused.
